meta.title: Bea & Gábor — Wedding
meta.description: Bea & Gábor's wedding — 2026.08.22. • Ceremony 16:00 • Celebration 18:00 • Magic Harghita Resort

hero.subtitle: Wedding
hero.lead: Join us on this special day when we officially unite our lives!

rsvp.title: RSVP
rsvp.description: Help us with planning by sending a quick response! Please let us know your attendance intention and any dietary restrictions:
rsvp.deadline: Please respond via the form below by August 1.

location.title: Locations
location.ceremonyDirections: The ceremony will take place at the Reformed Church in downtown Odorheiu Secuiesc at 16:00.
location.celebrationDirections: The celebration will take place at the magical Magic Harghita Resort, which awaits us deep in the forest, on a quiet clearing. Coming from Odorheiu Secuiesc, turn left at Căpâlnița from the main road. From there, a 3 km road leads through the clearing, straight to the Resort gate where parking is also available.

accommodation.title: Accommodation
accommodation.limited: The number of places at the Resort is limited, and we reserve them primarily for our family members.
accommodation.costs: If you send us your feedback by August 1, we can recommend accommodation at your own expense in the nearby village of Căpâlnița.
accommodation.moreDetails: If you need accommodation contact details, please let us know via the form below
